title: Legal litigation management bundle
description: Case-file and court-filing evidence for governed litigation management.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: legal-litigation-management
  title: Legal litigation management bundle
  description: Case-file and court-filing evidence for governed litigation management.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-legal-02
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/legal
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [legal_matter.case_name, legal_matter.case_status, legal_matter.case_number, court_filing.filing_date]
      relationshipIds: [has_party, involves, contains]
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/legal/litigation_case_file, role: supporting }
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/legal/court_filing, role: supporting }
